metadata.name: Romanization of Ukrainian (2012)
notes:
Diffed against the Romanization of Ukrainian for Geographical Names table
 as published in the WGRS Report on the Current Status of UN Romanization Systems
 for Geographical Names, version 4.0 (February 2013) (eki.ee/wgrs/rom1_uk.htm;
 also unstats wgrr4ukranian): all 34 rows verified. The system was approved by
 the UN in 2012 (X/9), based on the national rules adopted 27 January 2010;
 the name previously read 'Belarusian, Russian And Ukrainian Cyrillic (2012)',
 a carry-over from the 1998 map.

Row 4: h, with gh in the romanization of зг (zgh) — encoded by the
 dependency chain's Gh/gh before Зз rules. Rows 8/13/14/31/32: second variant
 (ye/yi/y/yu/ya) word-initially, encoded by the dependency chain's boundary
 rules; the word-initial variants are suppressed after the apostrophe per the
 national rules (not_before boundary + ’). Rows 33/34: ь and ’ are not romanized.
